</ul> </nav> <div id="et_mobile_nav_menu"> <div class="mobile_nav closed"> <span class="select_page">Select Page</span> <span class="mobile_menu_bar mobile_menu_bar_toggle"></span> </div> </div> </div> </div> </header> <div id="et-main-area"> <div id="main-content"> <article id="post-256" class="post-256 page type-page status-publish hentry"> <div class="entry-content"> <div class="et-l et-l--post"> <div class="et_builder_inner_content"> <div class="et_pb_section_4 et_pb_section et_section_regular et_block_section"><div class="et_pb_row_16 et_pb_row et_block_row et_animated"><div class="et_pb_column_32 et_pb_column et_pb_column_3_5 et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_image_6 et_pb_image et_animated et_pb_module et_block_module"><span class="et_pb_image_wrap"><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" src="https://www.kitetribe.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/el-gouna-kitepower-station.jpg" width="1200" height="900" srcset="https://www.kitetribe.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/el-gouna-kitepower-station.jpg 1200w, https://www.kitetribe.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/el-gouna-kitepower-station-980x735.jpg 980w, https://www.kitetribe.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/el-gouna-kitepower-station-480x360.jpg 480w" sizes="(min-width: 0px) and (max-width: 480px) 480px, (min-width: 481px) and (max-width: 980px) 980px, (min-width: 981px) 1200px, 100vw" class="wp-image-684" title="el-gouna-kitepower-station" alt="kite tribe kitesurfing spot" / loading="lazy"></span></div></div><div class="et_pb_column_33 et_pb_column et_pb_column_2_5 et-last-child et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_text_20 et_pb_text et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_module et_block_module et_pb_text_align_center"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h1 style="text-align: center;">Kitesurfing in El Gouna</h1>
<h2 style="text-align: center;">The Ultimate Spot for Wind Lovers</h2>
<p style="text-align: center;">Welcome to El Gouna, Egypt’s premier destination for water sports, sunshine, and good vibes all year round. Located on the beautiful Red Sea coast, El Gouna offers everything a kitesurfer or wing foiler could dream of: steady winds, flat turquoise water, and a vibrant international community.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><span style="color: #ff9900;">___________</span></p>
</div></div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_button_module_wrapper et_pb_button_2_wrapper"><a class="et_pb_button_2 et_pb_button et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_module et_block_module" href="https://www.kitetribe.org/contact-us/">Contact Us</a></div></div></div></div><div class="et_pb_section_5 et_pb_section et_section_regular et_block_section"><div class="et_pb_row_17 et_pb_row et_block_row"><div class="et_pb_column_34 et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_image_7 et_pb_image et_animated et_pb_module et_block_module"><span class="et_pb_image_wrap"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" src="https://www.kitetribe.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/el-gouna-kitepower-kite-launch.jpg" width="1200" height="899" srcset="https://www.kitetribe.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/el-gouna-kitepower-kite-launch.jpg 1200w, https://www.kitetribe.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/el-gouna-kitepower-kite-launch-980x734.jpg 980w, https://www.kitetribe.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/el-gouna-kitepower-kite-launch-480x360.jpg 480w" sizes="(min-width: 0px) and (max-width: 480px) 480px, (min-width: 481px) and (max-width: 980px) 980px, (min-width: 981px) 1200px, 100vw" class="wp-image-683" title="el-gouna-kitepower-kite-launch" alt="El gouna Egypt kitesurf paradise" /></span></div></div><div class="et_pb_column_35 et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et-last-child et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_text_21 et_pb_text et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_module et_block_module et_pb_text_align_center"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2 style="text-align: center;">El Gouna: A Paradise for Kiters</h2>
<p>Founded in 1989, El Gouna has evolved from a serene spot with a single hotel and a handful of villas to a vibrant haven where passions come to life. Located just 25 km north of Hurghada, this unique town offers everything from kitesurfing, diving, and horse riding to wellness, yoga, and relaxation. In El Gouna, every day is a chance to live your passion, be it seeking adrenaline-fueled adventures or serene moments of bliss.</p>
<h3>Clean Wind and Safe Shores</h3>
<p>Situated in the northernmost part of El Gouna, our location is free from natural windbreakers like trees and hotels, ensuring uninterrupted and stable wind conditions for kitesurfing. The shore is free from dangerous corals, though we recommend water shoes to protect against occasional shells.</p>
</div></div></div></div><div class="et_pb_row_18 et_pb_row et_block_row"><div class="et_pb_column_36 et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_text_22 et_pb_text et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_module et_block_module"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2>Our Spot: A Kitesurfer's Dream</h2>
<p>We are located at the Kite Power Station in El Gouna. Our kitesurfing spot boasts a vast shallow area of crystal-clear water, extending 2-3 km in length and approximately 1 km in width up to the reef, making it an idyllic playground for kitesurfers and foilers alike. With sandy bottoms and no dangerous corals, our spot ensures a safe and enjoyable experience for everyone.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div></div></div><div class="et_pb_column_37 et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et-last-child et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_text_23 et_pb_text et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_module et_block_module"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2>Perfect Conditions for All Levels</h2>
<p>The water depth varies from 40-70 cm depending on the tide, offering conditions suitable for both beginners and advanced riders. At low tide, a short walk leads you to endless water, while at high tide, the water reaches chest depth, perfect for those looking to explore beyond the shallows. Our spot is renowned for its suitability for hydrofoil and wingfoiling, thanks to deeper waters beyond the reef and the absence of obstacles, providing clean and constant wind conditions.</p>
</div></div></div></div><div class="et_pb_row_19 et_pb_row et_block_row"><div class="et_pb_column_38 et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_image_8 et_pb_image et_pb_module et_block_module"><span class="et_pb_image_wrap"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" src="https://www.kitetribe.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/weather-chart-1.png" width="800" height="442" srcset="https://www.kitetribe.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/weather-chart-1.png 800w, https://www.kitetribe.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/weather-chart-1-480x265.png 480w" sizes="(min-width: 0px) and (max-width: 480px) 480px, (min-width: 481px) 800px, 100vw" class="wp-image-591" title="weather-chart" alt="wind and weather chart for kitesurfing in el gouna" /></span></div></div><div class="et_pb_column_39 et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et-last-child et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_code_2 et_pb_code et_pb_module"><div class="et_pb_code_inner">
<iframe id="embeddedFrame" src="https://kwind.app/widget/6703dfd421734c70c376eb70?background=Transparent&darkText=true&showHistory=false&show3dMap=false&showData=true&showForecast=false" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen width="100%" 
onload="(function(iframe){window.addEventListener('message',function(event){if(event.origin==='https://kwind.app'&&iframe&&event.data&&event.data.height){iframe.style.height=event.data.height+'px'}})})(this);
" loading="lazy"></iframe></div></div></div></div><div class="et_pb_row_20 et_pb_row et_pb_row_4col et_block_row et_block_row_4col"><div class="et_pb_column_40 et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_4 et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_text_24 et_pb_text et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_module et_block_module"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2><span style="color: #efc22f;">Wind</span></h2>
<p>We are so lucky to have amazing wind conditions year round! The Red Sea provides super stable wind for most of the year and during winter, we tend to get a mix of light and strong wind days. The optimum conditions for teaching are 12-26knots (22 - 48KPH). This is to ensure we have fun and safe kitesurfing lessons. Our kite instructors are highly qualified and always make decisions based on the safety of their students.</p>
</div></div></div><div class="et_pb_column_41 et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_4 et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_text_25 et_pb_text et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_module et_block_module"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2><span style="color: #efc22f;">Lagoon</span></h2>
<p>El Gouna has large, flat water lagoons perfect for all kitesurfing levels! The wind is side-onshore, direction North-North West and is typically an average of 15-25 knots. The water in the lagoon is really warm in the summer...get your tan on while kiting in shorts or a bikini!</p>
</div></div></div><div class="et_pb_column_42 et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_4 et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_text_26 et_pb_text et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_module et_block_module"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2><span style="color: #efc22f;">Temperature</span></h2>
<p>Temperatures in Egypt can reach high 30s in the summer, and pleasant low 20s in the winter. You can comfortably wear a bikini or board shorts and a lycra while kitesurfing in the summertime. It is recommended to wear short wetsuits for kiting in Spring and Autumn (May and June/September and October) and long wetsuits in the winter (December to April March).</p>
</div></div></div><div class="et_pb_column_43 et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_4 et-last-child et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_text_27 et_pb_text et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_module et_block_module"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2><span style="color: #efc22f;">Tide</span></h2>
<p>The lagoon is shallow enough to stand in all areas, but you can also kite in the deep water just a bit further out from the main teaching and riding areas. There is plenty of space for everyone - beginners, advanced, students or independent kiters! The tides are a bit lower in the summer and typically higher in the winter.</p>
</div></div></div></div><div class="et_pb_row_21 et_pb_row et_block_row"><div class="et_pb_column_44 et_pb_column et_pb_column_4_4 et-last-child et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_text_28 et_pb_text et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_module et_block_module"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h3>Safety First: Our Divided Spot</h3>
<p>To ensure the safety and enjoyment of all our visitors, we have meticulously divided our spot into distinct areas:</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Beginners Area</strong>: Shallow waters ideal for newcomers to gain confidence and master the basics.</li>
<li><strong>Advanced Area</strong>: A mix of shallow and deep waters, challenging even the most experienced kitesurfers.</li>
<li><strong>Wingfoil/Hydrofoil Area</strong>: Deeper waters designed for the thrilling experience of foiling.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div></div></div></div><div class="et_pb_row_22 et_pb_row et_block_row"><div class="et_pb_column_45 et_pb_column et_pb_column_4_4 et-last-child et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_heading_2 et_pb_heading et_pb_module et_block_module"><div class="et_pb_heading_container"><h2 class="et_pb_module_header">Join the Tribe</h2></div></div></div></div><div class="et_pb_row_23 et_pb_row et_block_row"><div class="et_pb_column_46 et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_text_29 et_pb_text et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_module et_block_module"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p style="text-align: center;">Kite Tribe is more than a kiteschool; it's a community of enthusiasts driven by a shared love for the sport. Our spot in El Gouna offers not just perfect conditions for kitesurfing and foiling but also a chance to join a tribe of passionate riders. From beginners to pros, Kite Tribe welcomes everyone looking to embrace the wind, waves, and the incomparable joy of kitesurfing.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">Ready to embark on your kitesurfing journey in El Gouna's most sought-after spot? Join us at Kite Tribe, where the wind whispers your name, and the waters beckon your spirit. Adventure awaits!</p>
</div></div></div><div class="et_pb_column_47 et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et-last-child et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_contact_form_2
